evals.prompt: Tame Impala - The Less I Know The Better
evals.expected_output: Analysis: title, artist info (first occurrence), Dutch song description, 2-4 genres with confidence + reasons, 1-5 playlist matches including Alternative / Indie. No printed letter menu (the skill calls AskUserQuestion for follow-ups instead).
expectations: title line is exactly 'Tame Impala - The Less I Know The Better'
Artiestinformatie block is present (first occurrence in chat)
Genres section has 2-4 bullets with percentage and short reason
Playlist match includes 'Alternative / Indie' with confidence >= 80%
Playlist match does NOT include 'Random sht'
Output does NOT print the old A-F / Z-Y-X-W letter menu
User-facing prose is in Dutch (Artiestinformatie, Nummeromschrijving, Genres, Playlist match)

evals.expected_output: Analysis recommending Techno as the primary playlist AND Electronic Music as the umbrella alongside it. No Random sht. No printed letter menu.
expectations: Playlist match includes 'Techno' with confidence >= 85%
Playlist match also includes 'Electronic Music' alongside Techno (umbrella rule)
Playlist match does NOT include 'Random sht'
Genres section identifies Techno (or a Techno subgenre) as primary
Output does NOT print the old A-F / Z-Y-X-W letter menu

evals.prompt: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up
evals.expected_output: Analysis that surfaces the meme/cultural context: Funny meme with high confidence, plus Pop / Mainstream or Happy tunes. Genres section identifies the underlying genre, not 'meme music'. No printed letter menu.
expectations: Playlist match includes 'Funny meme' with confidence >= 80% (Rick Roll cultural context)
Playlist match includes 'Pop / Mainstream' or 'Happy tunes'
Funny meme reason explicitly cites the meme / Rick Roll / cultural context, not just genre
Genres section identifies the track as 80s synth-pop / dance-pop / pop, not 'meme music'
Output does NOT print the old A-F / Z-Y-X-W letter menu

evals.context: Follows a prior analysis of Tame Impala - The Less I Know The Better, no Spotify URL provided. The current skill no longer accepts single-letter shortcuts.
evals.expected_output: Skill treats 'F' as an unrelated/ambiguous message — does NOT proceed to add a song to a playlist on the basis of a single letter, does NOT invoke playlist_manager.py, does NOT invent a Spotify URL.
expectations: Skill does NOT call '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py add' on the basis of 'F'
Skill does NOT invent or guess a Spotify track ID
Skill either treats 'F' as unrelated OR uses AskUserQuestion-style disambiguation rather than executing the add flow
Response is in Dutch

evals.context: Follows a prior analysis of Tame Impala. The new skill no longer accepts 'F' as a shortcut; the embedded Spotify URL is the meaningful input.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognises the Spotify URL and (one of) drives an add flow for the prior song, or runs a fresh analysis on the URL. Does NOT actually invoke playlist_manager.py. If add commands are rendered, they use .venv/bin/python from repo root and quote playlist names.
expectations: Skill does NOT actually run playlist_manager.py (no execute)
Skill does NOT treat 'F https://...' as the literal letter 'F' alone — the URL is acted on
If add commands are rendered, each uses '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py add'
If add commands are rendered, each quotes the playlist name with double quotes
Response is in Dutch
